theorems.name: Submission.deformation_good_center
theorems.statement: ∀ m ℓ : ℕ, 1 ≤ ℓ → ∃ c : ℝ≥0, ∀ μ₁ μ₂ : Measure (Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ)), IsFiniteMeasure μ₁ → IsFiniteMeasure μ₂ → ∃ a : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ), ∑ i, (a i - 1 / 2) ^ 2 < 1 / 16 ∧ ∀ La : Set (Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ)), La = {y | ∃ J : Finset (Fin (m + 1 + ℓ)), J.card = m + 2 ∧ ∀ i ∈ J, ∃ k : ℤ, y i - a i = k} → ∀ σ : ℝ, 0 < σ → σ < 1 / 4 → μ₁ {x | infDist x La < σ} ≤ c * ENNReal.ofReal (σ ^ (m + 2)) * μ₁ univ ∧ μ₂ {x | infDist x La < σ} ≤ c * ENNReal.ofReal (σ ^ (m + 2)) * μ₂ univ
